reason: Both propose the same plausible Mo-for-Nb substitution, but A is more specific and testable: it predicts a 5–10% strength reduction and >50% relative plastic-strain increase, defines a substitution series and phase constraint, and includes dislocation/lattice-distortion observations that probe the proposed mechanism. B is sound but leaves the expected plasticity gain largely unquantified and therefore offers a less decisive test.
